name: Honeybee nest-site choice with stop signals
question: How accurately does the population follow a weak bias when it is swept through its collective threshold, for N units and a given sweep rate?
assumptions: eq. (1) of the source without its sensory noise: gamma_i = rho_i = v_i, alpha_i = 1/v_i, v = 5, v_A = v + dv/2, v_B = v - dv/2 (dv the bias)
the demographic noise of N scouts in place of the sensory noise
the stop-signal rate sigma is swept through sigma* = 4v^3/(v^2 - 1)^2

provenance.source: D. Pais et al., PLoS ONE 8, e73216 (2013); T. D. Seeley et al., Science 335, 108 (2012)

carrier.name: fractions of scouts committed to A and to B
